tokens.source: orchestrator_usage (joint dispatch with SqrtBlock; includes the harness-flakiness investigation)

walltime: ~79m (incl. two blocked full-suite runs traced to pre-existing port-bound tests)
notes: JOINT-BUILD record: cost covers FeaturePairJoinBlock + SqrtBlock (one dispatch); the join carries the full cost (it drove the engine fix and the chain debugging), SqrtBlock is the smaller half. 1 cell, tier 3, placeKYT-native (no GR counterpart — GR's scheduler aligns streams, so this problem does not exist there). WHY IT EXISTS: a prior example attempt proved on real hardware that two nets driving one target entry BUILD and ROUTE with .ok True and SILENTLY EMIT GARBAGE (the target's toggle cell read the two streams as word0/word1 of ALTERNATING timesteps: 12 windows in -> 6 wrong class words out). The counting join is explicitly order-free (wrong primitive); broker coalescing collapses two nets to N WRITEs + ONE JUMP all targeting the same in_reg (second overwrites first); DualFloatToComplex has the right LOCK/face rendezvous but the wrong output shape (2-rail packet, one trigger). MECHANISM SHIPPED: Dual's LOCK-BY-FACE input half (face = stream identity, NEEDS_DISTINCT_INPUT_FACES, cold-start initial_lock_face to avoid an arm-JUMP race) + a NEW output half — two sequential WRITE+JUMP bursts from a single-rail cell. RAW_OUTPUT_HOPS/hand-routing NOT needed: _patch_cell_handoff already sets every WRITE and JUMP in the cell to the same (hop,dest,entry); two conditions keep that live and are asserted (exactly one output register; output cell free of internal handoffs/WRITE.CFG). ENGINE BUG FOUND+FIXED (load-bearing): _apply_rendezvous_input_faces hardcoded the Dual's port/word names, so for ANY other rendezvous block it was a SILENT NO-OP — the chain built and routed perfectly while emitting zero output; generalized to a block-declared RENDEZVOUS_FACE_PORTS (Dual's 8 tests stay green). MEASURED MECHANISM LIMIT (guard test): an arm may run at most 2 timesteps ahead; proven a property of the LOCK mechanism, not this block (the shipped Dual hits the identical boundary in the same chain). 32 tests EXACT tol 0, every proof on real placed+routed+built two-upstream chains, incl. END-TO-END through the real 51-cell GRUCellBlock to x16_out, bit-identical to feeding ordered pairs directly at the correct 1:1 rate. INV-4 mutations all FAIL incl. missing-LOCK (reproduces the measured garbage mode). PROCESS NOTE: the builder documented a limit derived from READING the build, wrote it as an executable guard, watched it FAIL, and corrected the docs rather than the test.
